notes.title: New Additions!
notes.content: [h3]More main menu options[/h3][p]More direct main menu options to take you where you want to go.[/p][p][/p][h3]A Darker UI mode toggle in Settings.[/h3][p]Where possible the in-game UI uses darker colours instead of team colours[/p][p][/p][h3]Name markers above heads in 3D match.[/h3][p]With different selections in SETTINGS.[/p][p]The default settings are show numbers for both teams.[/p][p][/p][p]        Squad HUD toggle on/off.[/p][p]        Show Numbers.[/p][p]        Show Names.[/p][p]        Show opponents team and show my team toggles.[/p][p][/p][h3]Darkened boxes like the advance box.[/h3][p][/p][h3]Player guide is now viewable in game[/h3][p]Accessible via the main menu options.[/p]

notes.title: CSV update
notes.content:
Added club ID column to all clubs export.
Added club name column to all players export.

Always verify integrity of files via Steam to ensure you are using the latest build.
Right click the game in the library and select properties.
Select Update, there you can see the Build ID for the release should be 17517828.
If it isn't, go to Installed Files and select Verify integrity of game files or restart the Steam client.

notes.title: Update Notes
notes.content:
2D Match UI improvement.
Cursor fix on mac.

notes.title: Patch note
notes.content: Fixed an issue with the help button where tips weren't being displayed.

notes.title: Tutorial error fix
notes.content:
Fixed a tutorial error that could occur after loading a save game.  Either when the tutorial was inactive
or wasn't used on that save game.

notes.title: Faster, more efficient performance update
notes.content:
Screen switching and lists are now significantly more responsive with better performance and memory management, providing a more user friendly UI experience.

We hope you enjoy this update.

notes.title: Fixes
notes.content:

notes.title: Patch and FAQ
notes.content:
Validation check and fix for where a save game has a fixture with two games on one day for the same team.  Thanks jonezie1803 for sending us a save game revealing this issue.

Added FAQ to social media buttons at bottom of main menu.
Clicking it will take you to our website FAQ URL for RUTM4.
It currently has more information about Morale in the game.
This URL will be updated to include more answers to your questions.

notes.title: Low Morale Advanced Customisation Options And Fixes
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Advanced customisation options have been added to the settings menu for experienced players to adjust morale settings.
[*]Fixed incorrect reporting of squad morale (was mistakenly using fitness value in one of the checks)
[*]Low Morale message threshold trigger now on a global setting that can be changed in settings.  Click Advanced Customisation
[*]Contract Rejection and breach morale loss value now on a global setting that can be changed in settings.  Click Advanced Customisation
[*]Unhappy with management morale loss value now adjustable in Advanced Custommisation.
[*]Morale boost for playing a player in the main squad now adjustable in Advanced Customisation menu and the default has been doubled to make quicker morale recovery when player is played.

[*]Fixed issue where some stats weren’t getting updated in a 3D match.
These are:-
Match start
Morale boost for playing in main squad
Morale decrease for not playing in the contracted primary position
Increase of average rating.
[*]Fixed bug where end of season link to staff list box kept coming up and preventing the submit training rota boxes coming up so user didn't know what to do to advance.
[/list]

notes.title: Fixes for save games made before the pre-season friendly fix
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fix for possibility of processing getting stuck on beginning new season on saves made 
before the pre-season friendly fix.
[*] Fix for incorrect announcement dates on saves made before the pre-season friendly fix.
[/list]
The fixes above will allow you to continue to play your pre-season friendly fix games.
However, it is recommended that you start a new one.

Thank you to jonezie1803 for sending us his save game.

notes.title: Fixes and added button to messages
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Fix to going into season 2 bug, where pre-season friendlies/job offers didn't trigger until 6th August.
This may also fix the processing getting stuck on club 405/406 bug reported.
[*]Button added to messages so that all player related emails can be deleted.
This will include the deletion of the many "Low Morale" emails.
[/list]

notes.title: Update:Fix to internationals
notes.content: Internationals have been fixed and now work.

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
Display of “Northampton Saints” in the scout screen when clicking on one of the filter options has been fixed. It will now show Amateur, Semi-Pro etc...

Social media Discord linked fixed, it now takes you to RUTM3/4 Discord.

A crash loading a workshop database has been fixed. It will now copy player photos and club badges from the workshop item to the correct places for the game.

Please note, regarding workshop items with player photos, competitions and badges:-

When selecting NEW GAME. There are three boxes. 1 for the database, 1 for the badges and competitions, 1 for the photos. You can choose not to load player photos. It defaults to leaving the photos empty option. If you want to copy the new Photos with the database you have to select it in the photos box.
